title: Inventory and port active artifact renderers
goal: Inventory artifact block usage across active EPP content and decide which runtime renderers must exist before full EPP migration.
acceptance_criteria: Active artifact payloads are counted by artifact type and renderer template
Required live runtime renderers for full EPP migration are listed
Rare, inactive, or unknown artifact blocks have graceful source-aware placeholder behavior until a runtime renderer exists
HVA workbook migration risk is called out separately
non_goals: Implementing all artifact renderers during inventory
Pre-rendering the full EPP corpus as the normal browse path
validation: Run an artifact inventory script over the EPP source repo
notes: This should happen before declaring full EPP workspace migration complete. Browse-time document rendering should stay source-driven; generated snapshots are for export, print, review, or disposable caches.
